name: member with no level defaults to editor
from: 'commenter'::public.collab_access_level)

name: owner not recognised
from: when public.agenda_is_owner(target_project) then 'owner'::public.collab_access_level

name: non-members get the default level
from: when not public.agenda_is_member(target_project) then null

name: levels given to anybody
anybody grants levels
from: for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_level(project_id) = 'owner');
to: for insert to authenticated with check (true);

name: anybody changes levels
from:
using (public.collab_level(project_id) = 'owner')
  with check (public.collab_level(project_id) = 'owner');

name: commenters create boards
from:
create policy "collab boards: editors create" on public.collab_boards
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_edit(project_id));
to:
create policy "collab boards: editors create" on public.collab_boards
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_comment(project_id));

name: viewers create items
from:
create policy "collab items: editors create" on public.collab_items
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_edit(project_id));
to:
create policy "collab items: editors create" on public.collab_items
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_view(project_id));

name: commenters move items
items readable by anyone
from:
create policy "collab items: read" on public.collab_items
  for select to authenticated using (public.collab_can_view(project_id));
to:
create policy "collab items: read" on public.collab_items
  for select to authenticated using (true);

name: boards readable by anyone
from:
create policy "collab boards: read" on public.collab_boards
  for select to authenticated using (public.collab_can_view(project_id));
to:
create policy "collab boards: read" on public.collab_boards
  for select to authenticated using (true);

name: board on another project accepted
from: raise exception 'That board is on another project.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: drawing on another project accepted
from: raise exception 'That drawing is on another project.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: revision of another drawing accepted
from: and r.drawing_id = (row_json ->> 'drawing_id')::uuid

name: parent on another board accepted
from: raise exception 'That column or group is on another board.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: task on another project accepted
from: raise exception 'That task is on another project.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: work assigned to outsiders
from: raise exception 'Work can only be assigned to somebody on the project.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: stale saves applied
from:
if new.revision <> old.revision + 1 then
    raise exception 'Somebody else changed this a moment ago. It has been reloaded.'
to:
if false then
    raise exception 'Somebody else changed this a moment ago. It has been reloaded.'

name: every save treated as bookkeeping
from:
if (to_jsonb(new) - 'last_activity_at' - 'updated_at')
     = (to_jsonb(old) - 'last_activity_at' - 'updated_at') then

name: items move between projects
from:
if new.project_id <> old.project_id then
    raise exception 'It cannot be moved to another project.'
to:
if false then
    raise exception 'It cannot be moved to another project.'

name: items move between boards
from: and (to_jsonb(new) ->> 'board_id') is distinct from (to_jsonb(old) ->> 'board_id') then

name: creator taken from the client
from: if row_json ? 'created_by' then new := jsonb_populate_record(new, jsonb_build_object('created_by', auth.uid())); end if;

name: comment author taken from the client
from: if row_json ? 'author_id' then new := jsonb_populate_record(new, jsonb_build_object('author_id', auth.uid())); end if;

name: thread numbers not given
from: new.number := public.agenda_next_number(new.project_id, 'collab_thread', 'C', 3);

name: commenters assign on opening
from:
if level not in ('owner', 'editor') then
      new.assigned_to := null;

name: commenters assign later
from: raise exception 'Only an editor assigns work.' using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';

name: commenters mark ready for review
from: raise exception 'Only an editor marks a correction ready for review.' using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';

name: pins move to another drawing
from: raise exception 'A comment stays where it was placed.' using errcode = 'check_violation';

name: approval not recorded
from:
new.resolved_by := auth.uid();
    new.resolved_at := now();

name: mentions reach outsiders
to:
from (select unnest(new.mentions) as user_id) m
  where m.user_id <> new.author_id;

name: replies notify nobody
from: union select thread.created_by

name: ready for review not sent back
from: values (new.created_by, auth.uid(), 'collab_review',
to: select new.created_by, auth.uid(), 'collab_review'::public.notification_kind, null, null, null where false; insert into public.notifications (user_id, actor_id, kind, title, body, href) select null::uuid, null::uuid, 'collab_review'::public.notification_kind,

name: self-assignment notifies
from: if new.assigned_to is not null and new.assigned_to is distinct from auth.uid()

name: anybody edits comments
from: using (author_id = auth.uid() and public.collab_can_comment(project_id))

name: commenters edit others' markup
from: using (public.collab_can_comment(project_id) and (created_by = auth.uid() or public.collab_can_edit(project_id)))

name: viewers comment
from:
create policy "collab threads: commenters open" on public.collab_threads
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_comment(project_id));
to:
create policy "collab threads: commenters open" on public.collab_threads
  for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_view(project_id));

name: read marks for others
from: for insert to authenticated with check (user_id = auth.uid() and public.collab_can_view(project_id));
to: for insert to authenticated with check (public.collab_can_view(project_id));

name: read marks visible to all
from: for select to authenticated using (user_id = auth.uid());

name: deletes allowed
from: execute format('revoke delete, truncate on public.%I from authenticated', t);

name: signed-out visitors keep grants
from: execute format('revoke all on public.%I from anon', t);

name: not published for realtime
from: execute format('alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.%I', t);

name: comment does not mark read
activity not logged
